units.namespaceAndKeyBytes: Complete admitted lookup namespace/key carrier bytes and privately observed match bytes, including repeated comparisons; does not enlarge the selected key codec ceiling.
units.privateContextArtifactBytes: Each complete original match/context artifact; original custody and containing archive limits also apply.
units.nativeEncodedRowBytes: Actual selected native transport framing/encoding, including private match/context columns; public projection is charged independently.
units.nativeSubmissions: All actual original data, context, authority and containment submissions; a retry is not free.
units.ownedPeakBytes: All request, key/context, adapter/decoder, catalog/owner and serialization buffers/copies still owned by the original call.

qualification: Finite unadopted proposals only. Exact native/transport/allocator/clock/cancellation producers and deployed feasibility remain required; independent dimensions apply together.
